title: Area of a Parallelogram
topic: Deriving Area = base x height by rearranging a parallelogram into a rectangle

items.prompt: When a parallelogram is cut and rearranged into a rectangle, which two measurements stay the same?
items.rationale: Sliding the cut triangle to the other side preserves both the base length and the height.

items.prompt: A parallelogram has a base of 10 units and a height of 6 units. What is its area?
items.rationale: Area of a parallelogram = base x height = 10 x 6 = 60.

items.prompt: The formula for the area of a parallelogram is:
items.rationale: Area of a parallelogram = base x height.

items.prompt: A parallelogram has a base of 8 units, a height of 5 units, and a slanted side of 9 units. What is its area?

misconception_key.B: used the slanted side instead of the perpendicular height (the target misconception for the representation study)
misconception_key.C: added base + height instead of multiplying
misconception_key.D: used only one dimension (base) and ignored height

items.rationale: Area = base x height = 8 x 5 = 40. The slant side (9) is a distractor and should not be used in the calculation.
